label: Orders
caption: SWENSON, JILL, ET AL. V. WI STATE LEGISLATURE, ET AL.
text: The application to vacate stay presented to Justice Kavanaugh and by him referred to the Court is denied. Justice Kagan, with whom Justice Breyer and Justice Sotomayor join, dissenting: I dissent for the reasons set out in Democratic National Committee v. Wisconsin State Legislature, 592 U. S. ___ (2020) (Kagan, J., dissenting).
